_note: Illustrative disposal knowledge base for the VYARTHX demo. Local authorities configure actual acceptance rules. Not a regulatory instrument.

items.name: Plastic water / soft-drink bottle
items.handling: Empty it, rinse lightly, crush it and put the cap back on.
items.disposal: Dry waste — recyclable plastic. Hand over with other clean dry recyclables.

items.name: Plastic container / shampoo or detergent bottle
items.handling: Empty and rinse. Check the resin code if visible; accepted types vary by local MRF.
items.disposal: Dry waste — recyclable plastic where the local MRF accepts it.

items.name: Plastic wrapper / multilayer packaging
items.handling: Keep dry and as clean as practical; stuff small wrappers into a bag so they do not scatter.
items.disposal: Dry waste. Low-value plastic: recovery depends on local MRF / EPR collection arrangements — acceptance is not guaranteed.

items.name: Cardboard / corrugated packaging
items.handling: Flatten the box, remove tape and plastic where practical, keep it dry.
items.disposal: Dry waste — clean cardboard is widely recyclable.

items.name: Food-soiled pizza / paperboard box
items.handling: Separate the clean lid from the greasy base where practical. Tear off food-soiled parts.
items.disposal: Clean portions: dry recyclable paper. Grease-soiled portions are usually not accepted for paper recycling — follow your local authority's instruction (often wet or reject stream).

items.name: Paper / newspaper / notebooks
items.handling: Keep dry. Bundle with string; shredded paper in a paper bag.
items.disposal: Dry waste — recyclable paper.

items.name: Beverage / milk carton (multilayer)
items.handling: Empty, rinse, flatten.
items.disposal: Dry waste — recyclable only through facilities that accept laminate cartons; confirm local acceptance.

items.name: Glass bottle / jar
items.handling: Empty and rinse. If broken, wrap the pieces in thick paper, label it 'glass' and keep it away from children.
items.disposal: Dry waste — glass recycling. Hand broken glass over wrapped and labelled.

items.name: Metal can / tin / aluminium can
items.handling: Empty and rinse. Do not crush aerosol cans — see special-care if the can is pressurised or held chemicals.
items.disposal: Dry waste — metals are high-value recyclables.

items.name: Aluminium foil / foil container
items.handling: Wipe off food. Ball up small pieces together.
items.disposal: Dry waste — clean foil is recoverable; food-soiled foil may be rejected.

items.name: Kitchen / food waste
items.handling: Drain excess liquid. Keep free of plastic, glass and metal. Use a compostable liner only if your local authority allows it.
items.disposal: Wet waste — composting or biomethanation.

items.name: Garden waste / flowers / leaves
items.handling: Remove plastic and wires from garlands. Keep it separate from food waste if composting locally.
items.disposal: Wet waste — composting.

items.name: Sanitary / diaper / used mask
items.handling: Wrap securely in paper or the pouch it came in and mark it. Never mix with wet or dry recyclables.
items.disposal: Sanitary waste stream — collected separately for safe treatment. Not recyclable.

items.name: CFL bulb / fluorescent tube
items.handling: Do not break it further. If broken, ventilate the room and keep children and pets away; do not use a vacuum cleaner. Place pieces in a sealed container and hand over to authorised collection.
items.disposal: Special-care waste — authorised collection point or designated service only. Never in ordinary dry recyclables.

items.name: Battery / power bank / button cell
items.handling: Do not crush, puncture or open. Tape the terminals of lithium cells. Keep dry and away from heat. Swollen or leaking cells need authorised handling only.
items.disposal: Special-care / e-waste — authorised collection only.

items.name: Expired medicine / medicine strip
items.handling: Keep in original packaging. Do not flush or burn. Keep out of reach of children.
items.disposal: Special-care waste — return to an authorised medicine take-back / collection point if available. Do not place in dry or wet waste.

items.name: Paint / solvent / pesticide container
items.handling: Keep closed in original container, upright and away from heat. Never mix chemicals or pour them into drains.
items.disposal: Special-care waste — authorised hazardous-waste collection only.

items.name: Mercury thermometer / device
items.handling: Do not touch spilled mercury and do not use a vacuum cleaner. Ventilate, keep people away and contact authorised hazardous-waste handling.
items.disposal: Special-care waste — authorised handling only.

items.name: Syringe / needle / blood-soiled item
items.handling: Do not recap, bend or handle. Place only in a puncture-proof container and call authorised biomedical-waste collection.
items.disposal: Special-care (biomedical) — authorised handling only. VYARTHX cannot declare it safe.

items.name: Electronic device / charger / appliance
items.handling: Do not dismantle or burn. Remove personal data and batteries only if they detach without tools. Keep dry.
items.disposal: E-waste — hand over only to an authorised e-waste collector / recycler. Consider repair or reuse first.

items.name: Clothes / textiles / footwear
items.handling: Wash and bag usable items. Wet or mouldy textiles go to dry waste.
items.disposal: Reuse / donate first; otherwise dry waste textile recycling.

items.name: Furniture / bulky household item
items.handling: List it for reuse or repair first. Bulky items need a scheduled bulky-waste pickup.
items.disposal: Reuse / repair exchange first; otherwise bulky-waste collection.

items.name: Books / stationery
items.handling: Keep dry. Reuse or donate before recycling.
items.disposal: Reuse / donation first; damaged books to paper recycling.

items.name: Construction / renovation debris
items.handling: Do not mix with household waste. Store separately; heavy and sharp.
items.disposal: Bulky / C&D waste — follow your local authority's C&D collection arrangement.

items.name: Thermocol / EPS foam
items.handling: Keep dry and break into bags to avoid scatter.
items.disposal: Dry waste — very low-value; acceptance depends on local MRF.
